summary: Response versions shows an agent's answer with a small bar under it to page through earlier versions, regenerate it and copy it. Each regenerated answer is kept as a new version, so the person can compare it with the ones before and keep the one they like.
use: When people regenerate answers and want to go back to an earlier one instead of losing it.
When you want a new version to stream in where the old one was, with a counter like 2 / 3.
When an answer sits in a chat thread and needs copy and regenerate controls right under it.
features: `versions` holds every version, oldest first. Previous and next arrows page through them with a counter between, and the current one can be controlled with `version` and `onVersionChange`.
Switching versions fades the old text out, then the new one comes in word by word.
While `streaming` is true, words fade in as they arrive, the arrows are disabled and regenerate does nothing.
`onRegenerate` adds a Regenerate button that spins when pressed. You add the new version and show it.
Copy puts the shown version on the clipboard, confirms with a check and calls `onCopy` with the text.

`status` shows quiet text beside the buttons, like "Writing a new version", and shimmers while streaming. `prompt` adds the person's message as a bubble above, and `bare={false}` gives the answer its own card.
a11y: The answer text is an `aria-live="polite"` region.
The arrows are labelled "Previous version" and "Next version", and Regenerate and Copy have `aria-label`s too.
With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, switching versions skips the fade-out delay.

faq.q: How do I stream a regenerated answer into a new version?
faq.a: In `onRegenerate`, append an empty string to `versions`, set `version` to its index and `streaming` to true, then update that string as tokens arrive. Set `streaming` back to false when it is done.

faq.q: Why are the arrows greyed out?
faq.a: They are disabled while `streaming` is true, and at the first or last version. That keeps people from paging away from an answer that is still being written.

faq.q: Can the answer contain formatting like lists or code?
faq.a: No. Each version is a plain string, split into words for the fade-in, so markup is shown as text.
